messages:
julia: FYI: Customers reported intermittent mTLS failures and 502 spikes in eu-west-3 after the midnight rotation. Seeing a pattern of handshake timeouts and audit log gaps. Anyone oncall?

omar: I'm seeing it too. Traces show clients timing out around 600-900ms during CertificateVerify.

tae: Can you drop a trace id? I'll pull logs and check KMS metrics.

julia: trace=trc-ew3-0422-c7e1. Sample logs:
```
2026-06-12T00:12:05Z svc-ingest -> proxy-ew3 handshake_start
2026-06-12T00:12:06Z proxy-ew3 handshake_wait 820ms
2026-06-12T00:12:06Z proxy-ew3 cert_served incomplete_private_key
2026-06-12T00:12:06Z svc-ingest -> proxy-ew3 fallback_to_tcp
```

omar: Interesting: `cert_served incomplete_private_key` usually means control-plane couldn't unwrap KMS key for that identity. rotator-bot: what was the rotator plan for eu-west-3?

rotator-bot: rotator run: batch=eu-west-3, start=2026-06-12T00:00:30Z, concurrency=4, intermediate=interm-2026-06-12, kms_errors=7, retries=3, finished=00:09:12Z.

tae: KMS metrics show a brief burst of ThrottleExceptions from 00:01-00:05 with elevated latency. Also found several AccessDenied events from an IAM tweak merged at 23:58 that removed `roles/kms.cryptoUser` from `rotator-sa` in eu-west.

julia: Wait — we had an RBAC cleanup PR that removed wildcard kms permissions and replaced them with region-scoped roles. Maybe the new binding mis-scoped the rotator service account causing intermittent denies during the rotator window.

omar: Control-plane keystore logs corroborate: `keystore: unwrap error AccessDenied` and then later `keystore: served cert chain but no private key cached`. Proxies then fail the handshake because there is no matching private key to complete CertificateVerify.

tae: Also audit-bot shows missing audit writes between 00:02-00:06: `audit.write failed: PermissionDenied` — the keystore service lost logger.write permission after the RBAC change, which triggered the keystore safety gate to avoid issuing session ticket keys without auditable writes. That gating is from the recent vuln-mitigation branch.

julia: So two issues overlapped: (1) RBAC diff temporarily removed kms:Decrypt for rotator SA causing unwrap denies; (2) Audit logger perms removed causing keystore to refuse ticket keys. Combined they increased full handshake rate and handshake latency leading to 502s.

omar: Remediation plan: immediate rollback of the IAM diff restoring kms:Decrypt and logger.write to rotator-sa and keystore service. Restart control-plane pods to pick up perms. Also pause rotator runs until RBAC and KMS throttles are resolved.

tae: I'll open the rollback terraform PR and request expedite. PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/iam/pulls/5128 (rollback rotator & keystore RBAC).

julia: Short-term hotfix: increase proxy ptls client handshake timeout to 8s to reduce fallbacks while we stabilize. I'll open a proxy PR for a config override.

rotator-bot: action queued: pause rotator for eu-west-3, schedule low-concurrency re-run once IAM rollback confirmed.

omar: Post-incident follow-ups:
- Add RBAC preflight smoke that verifies KMS unwrap and audit write (keystore smoke endpoints) before applying IAM changes.
- Add a rotator safety: if KMS unwrap error rate >0.1% over 5m, auto-pause and rollback current batch.
- Add alerting: OCSP staple missing OR `incomplete_private_key` log rate >0.2% in 10m -> page oncall.
- Capture timeline of KMS throttle events and IAM diffs in the postmortem.

tae: Also propose a small change to control-plane: when KMS unwrap fails, prefer serving the previous key and chain (cached) rather than serving a chain without a private key. That would reduce customer impact during transient KMS errors.

julia: Good idea. For compliance: audit-bot, please export the list of affected customer-facing endpoints and any SLO breaches in that window so I can notify CSM and compliance.

audit-bot: export complete. SLO window 00:00-00:15 UTC: 74 502s observed tied to handshake fallbacks. Affected customers: 3 tenant IDs. Audit trail: IAM diff id=iam-2026-06-11-rc9 removed roles in eu-west; rollback applied 2026-06-12T00:16Z.

omar: After rollback and restart, keystore unwrap succeeded and session_ticket metrics returned to normal by 00:21. Proxies show handshake latency back to baseline.

tae: Postmortem owners: infra/iam to own RBAC preflight (owner: @omar), cert/rotator team to implement safety pause (owner: @julia), keystore team to implement cached-key fallback (owner: @tae).

julia: I'll draft the incident report and include timeline, root causes (RBAC mis-scope + KMS throttle + gating behavior), and the mitigation items above. Marking incident P1 during the window.

omar: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist for immediate handoffs:
- [ ] merge IAM rollback and confirm KMS unwrap OK
- [ ] hotfix proxy handshake timeout -> 8s
- [ ] pause rotator and re-run with concurrency=1 after rollback
- [ ] add unwrap & audit-write preflight for RBAC changes
- [ ] implement cached-key fallback in control-plane

tae: I'll attach pcaps and keystore logs to INC-2026-2189.

julia: Closing thread here; will update incident ticket with the postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
